column3: “Resident aliens” is rendered “settlers”; the oath form “if there will be” becomes “surely there shall be neither.”
“Wadi” is rendered “brook,” and “on the face of the Jordan” as “east of the Jordan.”
“From the end of days” is rendered “after a while.”
“Food” is rendered “bread,” and “jar … jug” as “bowl … jar.”
“Do according to your word” is rendered “do as you have said.”
“Lad” is rendered “child,” and “to his inward parts” as “to him.”
“To his inward parts” is rendered “to him,” and “lived” as “revived.”
